reads.note: The avenue runs along the plate's top boundary (white north of it) and meets Montgomery Road (diagonal road with tracks) at the right edge of the plate. It continues east of Montgomery with a jog: the west leg centre is y~903 (edges ~857/950), the east-leg south edge is y~1000, and the east leg is cut by the plate edge at x 10746. Point is on Montgomery's centreline (west edge ~10617, east edge ~10725 at this y), midway between the two leg centrelines. If only the west leg counts, use ~(10682, 903). The Brewster name is not printed in the region. I identified the street by its 1700-block numbers, which match 1700-1730 at the 22-75 crossing. A second avenue at y~1290 also meets Montgomery at ~(10560,1300); it is a different street (1650-1667 numbers).
